description: Fixed 1200-episode custom subset of R2R val_unseen, with original episode IDs and matching FGR2R annotations.

fgr2r.validation: Only selected FGR2R records are canonical-hash checked; unrelated rows and JSON formatting may differ.

fingerprint.episode_sha256: Complete original episode object, including instruction tokens and reference_path.
fingerprint.gt_sha256: Complete official GT record for this episode ID.
fingerprint.fgr2r_sha256: Complete matched FGR2R row, converting new_instructions and chunk_view from Python literal strings to lists when necessary.
fingerprint.ordering: Manifest order is fixed; source_index identifies the original 1839-episode source. Source input reordering is accepted by ID, with the actual input index recorded separately.
